answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the hollow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ivory of the next round. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. The fable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution before the ledger credits work.
